title: Import connections
lead: The chosen hosts become connections in "{project}". No import takes over passwords: where there is no key, you are asked when connecting.
csvHint: First line with headings: {name}, {host} (or {hostname}, {address}), {port}, {user}, {protocol} (ssh, sftp, ftp, ftps), {key}, {group} — comma, semicolon or tab. Termius has no export format of its own; a table like this is the way.
mobaxtermHint: SSH sessions are imported with host, port, user, key and gateway. The format is not documented — look over the list before importing.
sshConfigHint: With {identityFile} it becomes a key file, otherwise the SSH agent. {include} and forwards are imported, {match} blocks are not.
emptyDescription: There is nothing in this source that could be imported.
jumpResolved: goes via {hops} — imported as a jump host
jumpMissing: goes via {proxy} — for that, {hops} must be imported too
skipped: {n} entry cannot be imported | {n} entries cannot be imported
